text:
Nadia: Elmbridge pilot wrap — they agreed to a short case study + an optional customer webinar. Need a signed release and exact quote text before we draft assets.

Tom: We have two slot options for the interview: Mon 9am PT or Tue 3pm PT. Which works for the customer?

Felix (Elmbridge): Tue 3pm PT is best for us. We'll provide the benchmark CSV and a VP signature on the release after legal redlines.

Claire (Legal): Paste the proposed quote here. If it includes specific percentages or multipliers, attach the supporting data. We'll include an embargo option and a translation-approval line in the release.

Nadia: Draft hero: "Elmbridge improved peak throughput by 3.3x and saw approximately 45% lower inference cost over a 30-day test." Thoughts?

Claire (Legal): '3.3x' and 'approximately 45%' are fine if the CSV is attached. We'll require a measurement window in the release and a data-source sentence: "Benchmarking conducted over a 30-day test; data provided by Elmbridge."

Felix (Elmbridge): We'll upload the CSV and consent to 'approximately 45%'. Prefer a 5-day embargo post-publish. We'll sign once the redline is applied.

Tom: Locking Tue 3pm PT. I'll add a 15-min internal pre-call at 2:45pm PT for run-through.

Nadia: Sales routing note — when published, route demo interest to Elmbridge AEs and tag leads with "elmbridge-pilot". @sales-ops can you set up the SFDC campaign + webhook?

sales-ops: Yep. I'll create the SFDC campaign and webhook. Need the tentative launch date and the campaign name.

Felix (Elmbridge): Tentative launch target is two weeks after publish; we'll confirm after the interview. Campaign name can be "Elmbridge Pilot - Redwood" unless you prefer something else.

Claire (Legal): I uploaded a redline with the embargo clause and the data-source line. Link: https://legal.redwood/redlines/4987654321. Note: translations must be approved by the customer before distribution.

Nadia: Perfect. Action items: Elmbridge to upload CSV + sign release, Legal to finalize release, SalesOps to create SFDC campaign, Events to prep webinar stub, Marketing to draft blog + social. I'll start a copy-approval thread once the signed release is attached.

Ivy (Events): I'll create the webinar stub and reserve a co-host slot. Will only promote after release is signed and embargo window is clarified.

Tom: Invite sent (Tue 3pm PT) and internal pre-call created.

Felix (Elmbridge): Signed release uploaded: https://files.elmbridge/pilots/redwood-30d.zip. Thanks — see you Tue. :rocket:
